referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This infrastructure process includes land use, buildings and facilities (including dismantling) of a typical biomass gasifier. Process includes the dryer, the comminution equipment, the gasifier and the gas treatment and conditioning facility.
referenceFunction.name: Synthetic gas plant

technology.text: Swiss production of syngas is limited to pilot-scale fixed-bed gasifiers (Pyroforce, Xylowatt). Data is not specific to the technology (i.e. fixed bed or fluidised bed).

representativeness.productionVolume: Installed CH syngas production capacity is 1-1.2 MWth out of 2 units.
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Dataset was adapted from ecoinvent process 'industrial furnace, coal, 1-10 MW'.
